verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.rootly.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Rootly summary header), and the docs are served as plain markdown pages (.md URLs across on-call, alerts, AI and MCP sections), which suits agent consumption. The API overview also links a downloadable OpenAPI spec for agents. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-oriented docs offering (e.g., an llms-full.txt or explicit guidance for agents), and independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
